note: Book order. The generator fills these slots in this sequence. Do not shuffle.

slots.title: Short Title and Citation
slots.brief: This compilation is the Codex of the Mages' Guild, cited C.C.D. State who may cite it in filings. Dry.

slots.title: Enacting Authority; Autumnwood Accords Desk
slots.brief: The Accords Desk issues this title. Conservators and Innovators both sit. Neither may pretend the other does not exist.

slots.title: How to Read This Codex
slots.brief: Shall, may, must, Quiet List, reserved, see also. A reader who skips definitions is still bound. Trip the impatient.

slots.title: Persons Bound
slots.brief: Members, apprentices, temporary mouths, constructs holding a quill, guests who cast inside a Guild hall. Mike is not a person bound. Grime is not a Guild office.

slots.title: Relation to Other Law
slots.brief: Iron Mandate is rival law, not this title. Diet acts are not Guild stamps. Wario Coin is not tender. Heartstone talk is speech until surveyed.

slots.title: Definitions
slots.brief: Define caster, value, material alteration, transfiguration, disclosure, familiar, pocket, Quiet List, Paradox Trial. Numbered terms. Boring on purpose.

slots.title: Construction; Aggregation of Conduct
slots.brief: Fragmentation of conduct shall not prevent a finding of violation. Same rule as the filed photo.

slots.title: Effective Date; Savings
slots.brief: Prior Accords remain. Dead citations in Part XIV do not revive repealed schemes.

slots.title: Seals, Stamps, and What Is Not a Seal
slots.brief: Garlic bread on a map is not a seal. A concussed unnamed pilot is not a certifying officer.

slots.title: Reserved Catchlines
slots.brief: How reserved sections work. A blank is still a place in the book.

slots.title: Guild Offices Named
slots.brief: Accords Desk, Clerk, Conservator chair, Innovator chair. No new characters.

slots.title: Who May Speak for the Guild
slots.brief: Temporary mouths expire. A familiar's nod is not a speech unless the familiar is listed.

slots.title: Quorum of the Desk
slots.brief: One Conservator and one Innovator, or a clerk and a headache.

slots.title: Records of Speech
slots.brief: Spoken votes that are not filed are rumors. File before bragging.

slots.title: Conflict of Interest in Casting
slots.brief: A member may not stamp their own transfiguration of inventory.

slots.title: Delegation to Clerks
slots.brief: Clerks may refuse a stamp for incompleteness without a duel.

slots.title: Foreign Halls and Courtesy
slots.brief: A stamp from another hall is evidence, not law, until recorded.

slots.title: Emergency Sitting
slots.brief: Unscheduled weather is not by itself an emergency sitting.

slots.title: Licensure Required
slots.brief: No public casting for value without a current license.

slots.title: Apprentice Limits
slots.brief: An apprentice may fetch, not bind. Ink that recants is not a master's signature.

slots.title: Temporary Mouths
slots.brief: Duration, midnight rule, bags of holding.

slots.title: Suspension and Lapse
slots.brief: Lapse is not a Paradox Trial. It is paperwork.

slots.title: Guest Casters
slots.brief: A guest who charges a fee is not a guest.

slots.title: Constructs That Hold a Quill
slots.brief: Service of process on a construct. Swords do not receive mail.

slots.title: Schedules of Arts
slots.brief: Schedule A ordinary, B restricted, C Quiet List. Do not reciting C in taverns.

slots.title: Necromancy; Unsanctioned Arts
slots.brief: Forbidden unless a numbered permit. Innovators still file.

slots.title: Quiet List Procedure
slots.brief: How an art is listed without a public catalogue.

slots.title: Reclassification
slots.brief: Moving B to A is not a party.

slots.title: Research Copies of Quiet Items
slots.brief: Copies are still Quiet. Talking about them is not.

slots.title: Research Permits
slots.brief: Form, fee, who signs.

slots.title: Pocket Dimensions as Labs
slots.brief: Hours inside a pocket are still hours for the other party.

slots.title: Borrowed Hours; Interest in Time
slots.brief: Time-stop during settlement is still time.

slots.title: Specimen Custody
slots.brief: A petrified monster is inventory, not a trophy, until released.

slots.title: Unauthorized Titan Growth
slots.brief: Growth magic in a street is field use, not research, even if someone later studies it.

slots.title: Field Casting for Value
slots.brief: Public safety distance, notice to non-casters.

slots.title: Unscheduled Weather
slots.brief: Calling weather for agricultural advantage. Insurance does not cover weather you called.

slots.title: Corridor Courtesy After an Explosion
slots.brief: Who files first. Who sweeps.

slots.title: Healing Offered as Consideration
slots.brief: Unlicensed healing sold as a contract term.

slots.title: Love Philtre and Undue Influence
slots.brief: A philtre is not consent.

slots.title: Contracts with Non-Casters
slots.brief: Plain language. Illusion of a signature is not a signature. Illusion of a fee is still a fee.

slots.title: Familiars as Agents
slots.brief: Vicarious casting. Strike by familiar.

slots.title: Geas as an Unconscionable Term
slots.brief: A geas to be reasonable is not a defined term.

slots.title: Construct Labor; Minimum Ward
slots.brief: Wards, rest, who is paid.

slots.title: Summoned Notary
slots.brief: Form requirements. A summoned notary who vanishes mid-stamp.

slots.title: Evidence Generally
slots.brief: What a filing must contain.

slots.title: Scrying of Closed Books
slots.brief: Warrant. Spoliation even if nothing was taken.

slots.title: Memory Charm as Spoliation
slots.brief: Forgetting is not a defense if you paid for the forgetting.

slots.title: Simulacrum Testimony
slots.brief: A copy may not swear for the original.

slots.title: Clone as Duplicate Claimant
slots.brief: One claim. The later body files an amendment.

slots.title: Discipline; Range of Sanctions
slots.brief: From fee to seal to pocket-prison. Paradox Trial named.

slots.title: Paradox Trial Procedure
slots.brief: Peers, record, no street duel unless scheduled.

slots.title: Seal of Silence; Duration and Review
slots.brief: How long a mouth stays quiet.

slots.title: Duel Stakes Converted to Fees
slots.brief: If they insist on a duel, the Desk still invoices.

slots.title: Pocket-Prison Procedure
slots.brief: Who holds the key. Visiting hours are a rumor.

slots.title: Duty to File Before Casting
slots.brief: If value, composition, or risk will move, file first.

slots.title: Reporting of Material Enchantments
slots.brief: Thresholds. Late reports accrue per sunrise in the caster's original time zone.

slots.title: Record Retention
slots.brief: Seven years or one geological age, whichever the clerk finds funnier.

slots.title: Identify Fees; Who Pays
slots.brief: The person who asked. Not the Desk.

slots.title: False Provenance of Relics
slots.brief: A story is not a chain of title.

slots.title: Financial Fraud and Manipulation Generally
slots.brief: General prohibition. Cross-ref later 1001 sections.

slots.title: Prohibited Spells in Financial Markets
slots.brief: Named classes. Quiet List stays quiet.

slots.title: Valuation After Alteration
slots.brief: Who assays. Petrified inventory is still inventory.

slots.title: Illusion-Based Fraud
slots.brief: Illusion of goods, of price, of a buyer.

slots.title: Material Alteration of Traded Goods
slots.brief: MATCH THE FILED PHOTO: aggregation; permissible transfiguration; disclosure; burden; cross-refs; historical annotations C.C.D. 6125 / 7355 / 10155.

slots.title: Endowments and Gifts of Magical Assets
slots.brief: A hat that later bills the wearer is an endowment. Catchline from the photo.

slots.title: Disclosure of Composition, Value, and Risk
slots.brief: Full and accurate. True in a language the buyer does not speak is not full.

slots.title: Lead-to-Gold; Reporting Threshold
slots.brief: Lead remains lead for tax until the assay desk agrees.

slots.title: Polymorph of Coinage
slots.brief: Shape is not denomination.

slots.title: Invisibility of Liens
slots.brief: A hidden lien is still a lien. An invisible one is a violation.

slots.title: Wish Used to Rewrite a Filed Return
slots.brief: A wish does not rewrite the stamp.

slots.title: Wario Coin; Non-Recognition
slots.brief: Private tender. Points even less so. Cite only to refuse.

slots.title: Bag of Holding as Off-Books Vault
slots.brief: Off-books is still books if a clerk can smell it.

slots.title: Secured Transactions in Bound Objects
slots.brief: Collateral that can walk away.

slots.title: Layered Transfiguration Schemes
slots.brief: Read as one scheme if a reasonable toad would be confused.

slots.title: Gifts That Later Move
slots.brief: A gift with a remaining geas is not a gift.

slots.title: Relics; Chain of Title
slots.brief: Provenance, Quiet List relics.

slots.title: Curse as Warranty Disclaimer
slots.brief: A curse is not 'as is' unless disclosed.

slots.title: Blessing of a Competing Vendor
slots.brief: A blessing sold against a rival is advertising, then fraud if it binds.

slots.title: Transit Stamps
slots.brief: Planar instability surcharge. Archie-related invoices are not a defense.

slots.title: Planar Tolls
slots.brief: Evasion. Corridor courtesy.

slots.title: Extraterritorial Casting into a Diet Chamber
slots.brief: Do not. File a letter instead.

slots.title: Cartography Sold as a License to Raid
slots.brief: One-T mountain. A map is a map. It is not a permit.

slots.title: Schedule of Fees
slots.brief: Named amounts in Guild marks. No Wario Coin.

slots.title: Penalties; Sunrise Accrual
slots.brief: Original time zone, not the pocket's.

slots.title: Appeals
slots.brief: Desk, then Paradox Trial, then nowhere useful.

slots.title: Who May Inspect
slots.brief: Clerks, named officers. Not a crowd.

slots.title: Historical Annotations; Form
slots.brief: How to write C.C.D. numbers, MR pages, weekdays.

slots.title: Dead Citations
slots.brief: A repealed section may be cited as history, not as a permit.

slots.title: Savings Against the Iron Mandate
slots.brief: This title does not repeal itself because an Empire shouted.
